purpose: Results that sources report or claim with AI assistance, mostly outside the Erdős set; entries on Erdős problems link their erdos:<n> node. Entries marked vetting=unvetted are extraordinary claims recorded only because a primary source exists. Values are copied from the cited source; nothing here is independently checked and no atlas status changes.
